import React from 'react'; export default function PropertyDetailsModal({ show, onClose, property, onScheduleVisit }) { if (!property) return null; // Mock data for "Neighborhood Insights" const insights = [ { label: 'جودة الطباعة', score: 95, icon: '🖨️' }, { label: 'وضوح الشرح', score: 90, icon: '💡' }, { label: 'شمولية الأسئلة', score: 85, icon: '❓' }, { label: 'تقييم الطلاب', score: 92, icon: '⭐' }, ]; // Book DNA (Randomized for demo) const dnaTraits = [ { name: 'نظرية', val: 70, color: '#ff6b6b' }, { name: 'تطبيق', val: 85, color: '#4ecdc4' }, { name: 'صعوبة', val: 60, color: '#ffe66d' }, ]; return (

{property.location?.neighborhood}

)}
